admin.backupIntro: Download a backup file of system data and settings, or restore from a file you saved earlier. Administrator privileges are required.
admin.backupExportDesc: Downloads a single backup file with users, teams, members, devices, gamification definitions, and related records.
admin.backupExportFail: Could not create the backup. Check your connection and try again.
admin.backupImportDesc: Pick a mode below, then read the short explanation under the list. When in doubt, use Merge.
admin.backupHelpMerge: Safe default. Updates rows that already exist when their IDs in the file match the database (users, teams, devices, gamification definitions). Can add new related rows from the file (for example team levels, memberships, badges) when parent records exist. Does not create brand-new users or teams that are missing in the database.
admin.backupHelpMergeUpsert: Same as Merge, and additionally creates any users and teams from the file whose IDs are not in the database yet. Passwords are restored from the backup when the file includes them for each user.
admin.backupHelpReplaceCatalog: Destructive. Clears catalog data covered by the backup (users, teams, devices, gamification setup), then loads the file so IDs match the snapshot. Operational history that is not in the export is removed — see the red warning.
admin.backupHelpFull: Only for an empty database. Imports the snapshot and assigns new IDs to everything. Use after a clean install or when the database has no users yet.
admin.backupModeFull: Full — empty DB only, new IDs
admin.backupModeFullHint: Full import fails if the database already has users. For a populated database use merge, merge + upsert, or replace catalog.
admin.backupReplaceCatalogWarn: Replace catalog permanently deletes operational data that is not in the export: action events, team join requests, device scans and statistics. Use only if you understand the risk.
admin.backupErrorUnknownMode: Unknown import mode. Use merge, merge + upsert, replace catalog, or full.
admin.backupErrorFullNotEmptyDb: Full import works only when there are no users in the database yet. Use merge, merge + upsert, or replace catalog.
admin.backupResultNewUsersTempPassword: New users were added from the snapshot. Passwords are restored from the backup when the file includes them for each user.
admin.backupResultAllUsersTempPassword: Full import completed. Passwords are restored from the backup when the file includes them for each user.
admin.backupResultCatalogReplacedWithPassword: Catalog was replaced from the file. History that is not in the export (action events, team join requests, device scans and statistics) was removed. Passwords are restored from the backup when the file includes them for each user.
admin.backupInvalidJson: The file is not in the expected format or is damaged.
admin.backupMergeNoChanges: No rows were changed (snapshot may be empty or keys did not match existing data).
